about: Owner-set boundaries of the autonomous trader. The AI cannot read or write this file through any interface; changing it is an owner action and every cycle records its SHA-256 in the ledger. Risk limits are the desktop app's own defaults (dkapp.config.RiskSettings: $100 capital, $20 per position, 2 positions, $2 daily loss).
instruments: the event's own stock or its sector ETF, only if in the app's curated universe
